The scientist {npc:Telas}, in Stonehome (Edron), wants to build his own golem in the style of the Yalahari. Over 13 missions you collect research notes all over the continent, steal parts from the Yalahar factories, charge yourself with energy, read books that give you headaches and fetch a golem head from Fenrock. At the end you get 25,000 experience, a {item:Golem Wrench} to tame a {wiki:Modified Gnarlhound} (mount), 5 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}, the achievement **Golem in the Gears** and you can trade with Telas.
The brilliant Yalahari created golems tailored to their needs, but that is no easy task for today's scientists.
Telas's house in Stonehome (go up the stairs)
{wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest} with at least mission 3 started (to enter the centre of Yalahar).
Plenty of money for travel (and for {npc:Black Bert}, if you want to buy quest items).
Optional: {wiki:The Thieves Guild Quest} so you can trade with {npc:Black Bert}.
Mission 10 (depending on the draw): {item:Key 3940} and {item:Key 3980} for Fibula; {item:Key 3012} for the Hellgate route.
or one of the {wiki:Secret Agent Tools}; for mission 3
highly recommended for mission 12 (the grates make you Drunk)
or the Haste spell; helps in missions 6 and 12
useful against the Worker Golems of mission 2
Keys for mission 10, if you get those sub-missions: {item:Key 3940} + {item:Key 3980} (Fibula) and {item:Key 3012} (Hellgate).
to leave Hellgate, Mintwallin, Shadowthorn and other caves
only if you do not have {spell:Levitate}: to go up 2 floors on the way out of Hellgate
or {item:Depth Galea}; without this you cannot dive into the Sunken Quarter (mission 8). {npc:Captain Max} sells it for 5000 gp
Access to the {wiki:Modified Gnarlhound} (mount) in Telas's laboratory
Possibility to **trade** with {npc:Telas} (he buys rare metals and crystals)
Extra gold (900–1500 gp) for each X, Y or repeated charge in mission 5
In mission 13: open the box in {npc:Telas}'s laboratory and use the {item:Golem Wrench} on one of the Modified Gnarlhounds in the cage.
Trades with Telas (rare metals and crystals)
After mission 13: say {key:trade} to {npc:Telas} to sell him rare metals and crystals.
After the removal of the {wiki:Target Dummy|Target Dummies}, this quest may no longer be worth the time and money. The main reward today is the mount and the achievement.
Several missions can be skipped by buying the item from {npc:Black Bert} (see the table at the start). Buying everything costs around **198,000 gp**.
The {item:Elemental Crystal|Elemental Crystals} account for almost half of that cost and the {creature:Earth Elemental|Earth Elementals} are weak: get them yourself.
In every mission, when you finish the objective, go back to {npc:Telas} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to hand in and receive the next mission.
0. Preparation: items you can buy from Black Bert
This table shows the quest items that {npc:Black Bert} sells. You only need it if you want to skip a mission.
Decide what to do yourself and what to buy
Look at the table and decide which missions you want to do by hand. To trade with {npc:Black Bert} you must have completed {wiki:The Thieves Guild Quest}.
Other players usually sell {item:Elemental Crystal|Elemental Crystals} much cheaper than Black Bert.
Telas wants the research notes of five scientists. You can visit them in any order; they send the notes by mail, you do not have to carry anything.

Travel to **Edron**: say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain in your city and you arrive next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. {wiki:Stonehome} is a small village **northeast** of Edron; {npc:Telas}'s house is right **southwest** of the village.
Ask Telas for the first mission

Go to **Stonehome** (Edron) and climb the stairs of {npc:Telas}'s house. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He asks you for the notes of {npc:Scutty}, {npc:Milos}, {npc:Boveas}, {npc:Cerdras} and {npc:Dreadeye}.
Climb up here to reach Telas
Go to the Edron Academy, 4 floors above the ground, and talk to {npc:Milos}: {key:hi}, {key:research notes}.

Go to **Kazordoon** and go down to {npc:Scutty}'s level (5 floors below the ground). Say {key:hi} and {key:research notes}. To reach Kazordoon, take the {wiki:Steamship} in Cormaya ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya) or in Farmine and say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}; you arrive at the underground harbour, next to {npc:Brodrosch}. To leave, go back to Brodrosch and say {key:cormaya} or {key:farmine}.

Leave **Thais** through the **north** gate and go to the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, just northwest of that gate. From there follow the {wiki:Route:Mintwallin|route to Mintwallin} (bring a {item:Rope}). When you reach the two ladders, go down either one and take a few steps **west**: you are at the gate of {wiki:Mintwallin}.
The two ladders to the Mintwallin gate
There are many minotaurs along the way ({creature:Minotaur}, {creature:Minotaur Archer}, {creature:Minotaur Guard}, {creature:Minotaur Mage}).
Go to {wiki:Mintwalin} and go down to the bottom (8 floors below the ground), where {npc:Boveas} is. Say {key:hi} and {key:research notes}.
Mintwalin is full of minotaurs. Go prepared to fight.

Climb back up to the Mintwallin gate and do the route in reverse to the {wiki:Ancient Temple} (use the {item:Rope} where needed). On the way back there is a shortcut: follow the **red** line to a hole with 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and then the **blue** line to the exit. From the Ancient Temple you return to Thais through the north gate.
Shortcut back: red line to the Bonelords' hole, then blue line to the exit
The shortcut is one-way only: the hole in the red circle lets you drop down, but there is no spot to use the Rope.

In **Ab'Dendriel**, go down to the lower floor (the shop area), go down again next to the little houses and go down once more. Head **south** and then **east** to the door with the *Hellgate* painting and open it with the {item:Key 3012} (the guard {npc:Elathriel}, nearby, sells it to you for 5000 gp). Right to the **north** there is a second door that also needs the key. Go through it and step into the portal to {wiki:Hellgate}; do not use the portal on the **west** side of the room, which takes you out.
The portal is one-way only. Before you enter, make sure you have a {item:Rope} and {spell:Levitate} (or 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels}): without them you cannot leave Hellgate.
Go down {wiki:Hellgate}, beneath Ab'Dendriel, to floor -4. {npc:Dreadeye} is **north of the library**. Say {key:hi} and {key:research notes}.
Dreadeye, north of the Hellgate library

There is no quick exit: go back the same way to the exit route and follow the {wiki:Route:Hellgate|Route:Hellgate}. Summary: follow the long corridor to the rope spot and climb up with the {item:Rope}; head **southeast** (Rotworms), go down, walk a little **south** and go up; head **south** and go up again; go **south** and go down the **first** hole; cross the big Ghoul room to the **west**, hugging the south wall, and go down the hole; head **northwest**, go up **2 floors** with {spell:Levitate} (or 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels}) and climb the ladder; head **southwest** and go up through the hole; pull the bridge lever if needed and follow the only way up (lots of {creature:Wasp|Wasps}). You come out on the surface near Ab'Dendriel.
Exit 1: follow the corridor and climb up with the rope
Exit 2: Rotworm cave and the first hole to the south
Exit 3: go up 2 floors with Levitate or Parcels
Exit 4: go up through the hole to the southwest
Exit 5: the bridge lever and the way to the surface
On the rope floor, do not wander off: one of the holes has a {creature:Giant Spider}. {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords} may also show up in the big room.
Go to **Carlin**. {npc:Cerdras} is on the floor above the druid spell shop. Say {key:hi} and {key:research notes}.
If you ask each scientist about {key:golems}, he explains the part of the research he did (theory, mechanics, construction, earth golems...). It is just lore, not mandatory.
Go back to {npc:Telas} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He confirms he has received all the reports.
You have to fetch a {item:Mago Mechanic Core} from the {wiki:Factory Quarter} of Yalahar. Alternative: buy it from Black Bert for 13,000 gp.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Telas}. He explains that you have to cool the core with a cannon at the right moment (when it is **red**) and then take it from a dispenser.

Telas is in Edron, but almost all of the following missions are in {wiki:Yalahar}. To get there, talk to {npc:Captain Max} on one of the boats **east** of the **Liberty Bay** harbour: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (400 gp). If you have already completed the *Searoutes around Yalahar* mission of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}, there are direct boats between Yalahar and Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais and Venore (from Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Venore). You arrive at the Yalahar harbour, **south** of the city centre.
Karith, boat at the Yalahar harbour

The {wiki:Trade Quarter} is next to the harbour. At the gate between the Trade Quarter and the {wiki:Factory Quarter} is the guard {npc:Peter}: say {key:pass} and the destination (the Factory Quarter) to get through. If you already have access to the gate mechanisms (In Service of Yalahar), you can use them too.
Peter, Trade Quarter / Factory Quarter gate
In the {wiki:Factory Quarter} of Yalahar, go down to floor -1. There are 2 {creature:Damaged Worker Golem|Damaged Worker Golems}: kill them.
Location of the Mago Mechanic Core in the Factory Quarter

Go down to floor -2. Here there are 3 {creature:Worker Golem|Worker Golems} that usually wander near the stairs. Bring a blocker and maybe {item:Thunderstorm Rune|Thunderstorm Runes}, or a sorcerer with {spell:Rage of the Skies} to clear the room.

Go down to floor -3. There are 5 {creature:Worker Golem|Worker Golems}, but normally only 2 are near the stairs; the other 3 roam the area. Run **north**, go through the quest door and go down the stairs.
Fire the cannon at the red column

In the quest room there are several {item:Elemental Cannon|Elemental Cannons} (they look like telescopes) and {item:Crystal Column|Crystal Columns}. Use a cannon when the column in front of it is **red**. If you fire at a **green** column nothing happens. Each cannon takes **5 seconds** to reload.
Stay next to **just one** cannon and wait for the column to change colour, instead of running after the red columns.
Take the core from the dispenser
After hitting a red column, go to the {item:Core Dispenser} (the "last step" of the room) and use it. You receive the {item:Mago Mechanic Core}.

Go back the same way: climb the stairs of the quest room, go through the quest door and climb through floors -3, -2 and -1 up to the surface of the Factory Quarter. Leave through {npc:Peter}'s gate ({key:pass} and the destination) to the Trade Quarter and the harbour. To get back to Telas, take a boat: with {npc:Karith} (if you already have the In Service of Yalahar routes) go to Venore and from there to Edron with the harbour captain ({key:edron}); otherwise, {npc:Captain Cookie}, on the boat to the left of Karith's, takes you to Liberty Bay (400 gp) or Thais (800 gp), and from there you take the boat to Edron.
Karith, boat at the Yalahar harbour
You need 10 {item:Elemental Crystal|Elemental Crystals}. Alternative: buy them from Black Bert (80,000 gp) or from other players (much cheaper).

Kill {creature:Earth Elemental|Earth Elementals} and use a {item:Pick} (or one of the {wiki:Secret Agent Tools}) on the corpse. Not every corpse gives a crystal. Repeat until you have **10** {item:Elemental Crystal|Elemental Crystals}.
After you hand in this mission you **can no longer use the pick on Earth Elementals to obtain diamonds**. Think about that before moving on.
Telas lends you a {item:Golem Disassembler}. You need 6 {item:Golem Part|Golem Parts}.
Ask for the mission and receive the disassembler
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Telas}. He gives you the {item:Golem Disassembler}.

Kill {creature:Worker Golem|Worker Golems} or {creature:Damaged Worker Golem|Damaged Worker Golems} in Yalahar and use the {item:Golem Disassembler} on the corpse (wait a moment after death, but not too long). Not all of them give a part. Collect **6** {item:Golem Part|Golem Parts}.
You get electrocuted: 4 turns of 25 damage.
You can also "resurrect" the dead golem.
Wiki statistic: Damaged Worker Golems dropped a part in 26 of 100 attempts; Worker Golems in 8 of 24.
You are the "carrier" of the charges. You need to deliver charges **A**, **B** and **C** to Telas.
Get charged at the Charging Machine

Go to the {wiki:Alchemist Quarter} of Yalahar and go down to the {item:Charging Machine} (2 floors below the ground). Walk through it to receive a random charge: A, B, C, X, Y or Z. To enter the {wiki:Alchemist Quarter}, use the gate mechanism (if you unlocked it in In Service of Yalahar) or get past the guards: in the {wiki:Foreigner Quarter}, {npc:Tony} lets you through to the Arena and Zoo Quarter and there {npc:Hal} lets you through to the Alchemist Quarter (say {key:pass} and the destination to each). To leave, go up the two floors and return the same way.
Go back to {npc:Telas} and say {key:mission}. He tells you which charge you brought. Repeat (machine → Telas) until you have delivered **A, B and C** — at least 3 trips.
Counts for the mission (*"You brought an A-charge."*)
Counts for the mission (*"A B-charge! Incredible!"*)
Counts for the mission (*"We have got a major C-charge!"*)
Does not count; you receive 1500 gold
Does not count; you receive 1200 gold
Does not count; you receive gold
Does not count; you receive 900 gold
Telas wants a {item:Golem Blueprint}. Alternative: buy it from Black Bert for 13,500 gp.
Get to the War Golems room

Go back to the {wiki:Factory Quarter}. Go down, go through the quest door, head **south** and go down the hole. To the **north** there is a room with about 10 {creature:War Golem|War Golems}. Enter the Factory Quarter as in mission 2 (guard {npc:Peter}: {key:pass} and the destination).
A single War Golem can take 500+ health from you. It is very easy to get cornered if you run through the room with nobody distracting the golems.

Of the 10 golems, **4 are real** and **6 are "summons"**. Lure the real ones, one at a time, to the entrance and kill them. The summons give no experience or loot, respawn as soon as they die and cannot be lured: they always return to their spot to guard the chest.
Open the box on the other side of the wall

The box with the {item:Golem Blueprint} is on the **other side of the wall**. One player lures the 6 summons to the **right** side of the wall; at the same time another uses {spell:Haste}, runs along the **left** side to the box, uses it and returns the same way. Each team member does this in turn. After everyone has the blueprint, leave the room through the entrance and return to the surface the same way: go up through the hole you came down (bring a {item:Rope}) and up the stairs.
After you complete this mission you **cannot enter** this room again.
You have to fetch an {item:Old Power Core}. Alternative: buy it from Black Bert for 13,000 gp.

Go to the **west** side of the {wiki:Alchemist Quarter}, where the new quest door is. Inside there are 4 {creature:Mutated Human|Mutated Humans}, 3 {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares}, 3 {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers} and 2 {creature:Plaguesmith|Plaguesmiths}. Block them or kill them and pick up the core, which is **in front of the door**. Enter the Alchemist Quarter as in mission 5 and, with the core, leave through the same quest door and the same way.
Location of the Old Power Core
You need a {item:Stabilizer} from the {wiki:Sunken Quarter}. Alternative: buy it from Black Bert for 12,500 gp.

Go to the {wiki:Sunken Quarter} of Yalahar and dive. Underwater, go down at {coord:32940,31182,10}, continue and go down at {coord:32964,31182,11}. Up to here you only find {creature:Quara Constrictor|Quara Constrictors} and {creature:Quara Mantassin|Quara Mantassins}. From the Factory Quarter, get into the {wiki:Sunken Quarter} through the guard {npc:Oliver} ({key:pass} and the destination). To dive you need a {item:Helmet of the Deep} or a {item:Depth Galea}.
Continue **south** and use {spell:Levitate} to go down at {coord:32950,31205,12}.
When you arrive below, 2 {creature:Quara Pincher|Quara Pinchers} and 1 {creature:Quara Hydromancer} are waiting for you. You can get through the quest door very quickly and avoid the fight.
Go through the quest door and walk **north**, into the building. There you find a box with the {item:Stabilizer}.

Go back the same way: leave through the quest door, use {spell:Levitate} to go up where you levitated down ({coord:32950,31205,12}), go up at the two spots where you went down ({coord:32964,31182,11} and {coord:32940,31182,10}) and return to the surface. Do not take off the helmet while you are underwater.
You have to reconstruct the golem ritual by reading the books in the library in the centre of Yalahar. It depends a lot on luck.

Enter the **centre of Yalahar** (you need mission 3 of In Service of Yalahar) and go down at {coord:32785,31195,7}. Walk **east**, go through the quest door and go down the stairs: you arrive at the library at {coord:32800,31195,9}.
Go down here in the centre of Yalahar
A {creature:War Golem} is waiting for you in the library.

There are 8 {item:Yalahari Folio} books in the library. Read **1 to 5 books in a row** without getting a headache. The number of books needed varies: you may get lucky on the very first one. If you get teleported to the {wiki:Ghostship}: go down the ladder, follow the bridge **south** (there are {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}), climb the ladder in the **northeast** corner and step into the portal (guarded by a {creature:Ghost}): you end up in **Darashia**. From there you have to return to Yalahar.
Failing can make {creature:War Golem|War Golems}, {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} or {creature:Enraged Bookworm|Enraged Bookworms} appear, and even teleport you to the {wiki:Ghostship}.

Use the {item:Yalahari Inkwell} in the centre of the room to write the formula. If you do not have a headache and you are lucky, you complete the ritual. Otherwise, go back to reading books and try again.
If you get a headache, wait about a minute for it to pass or use a {item:Headache Pill} to try again right away. You may need 10–30 pills if you do not want to wait.
Go up the library stairs, go through the quest door, walk **west** and go up at the spot where you went down ({coord:32785,31195,7}) to return to the centre of Yalahar.

Telas asks you for **3 ingredients**, one at a time, chosen at random from 6 possible ones. For each one say {key:mission} and {key:yes}, go and get it and hand it in with {key:mission}. You can also buy them from Black Bert (37,500 gp for the 3).
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Telas} and answer {key:yes}. He tells you which ingredient it is. Check the table to see where it is.
{wiki:Fibula}: quest door in the northern part of the dragon cave (north of the spawn of 3 {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords})
{wiki:Dark Cathedral}: after the teleport, go north and then east to the quest door ({coord:32629,32446,10})
Drefia, first floor of the {wiki:Vampire Crypts}, to the northeast ({coord:32995,32405,12})
In a {item:Sarcophagus} behind a quest door
Underground quest door, in the same room as the {wiki:Time Ring Quest}
{wiki:Orc Fortress}: one floor up, on the Ulderek's Rock mountain, in the northeasternmost corner of the fort ({coord:32975,31712,7})
{wiki:Hellgate}, beneath Ab'Dendriel: in the same room as the spawn of a single {creature:Giant Spider}, on the way to Hellgate

If you get the {item:Shadow Orb}: in the {wiki:Dark Cathedral}, go through the teleport, head north and then east to the quest door. The {wiki:Dark Cathedral} is **west** of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc|Plains of Havoc} (southwest of Venore), south of the Outlaw Camp. The first two floors go down by stairs; the third can only be reached through the teleport: from the bottom of the stairs on the 2nd floor always head **south** to the big room. Before you step into the teleport, at the end of the room, you have to pull the **6 levers** in the 5 rooms around it, within a time limit (between 30 seconds and 2.5 minutes): do this as a team or kill everything first and pull the levers on a second run. To leave, go back the same way and climb the stairs.

If you get the {item:Dark Essence}: in Drefia, enter the first floor of the {wiki:Vampire Crypts} and head northeast. The {item:Sarcophagus} is behind a quest door. {wiki:Drefia} is **west** of Darashia, on the other side of the mountains (for example, climb the mountain with the {item:Rope} at {coord:33048,32429,7}). The {wiki:Vampire Crypts} are beneath Drefia and have their own entrance. To leave, go back the same way to the surface (bring a {item:Rope} for the holes) and cross the mountain back to Darashia.

If you get the {item:Bloodkiss Flower}: in {wiki:Shadowthorn}, the quest door is underground, in the same room as the {wiki:Time Ring Quest}. The flower is in a {item:Dead Tree}. To get there, leave **Venore** through the **east** exit and cross the swamps **southeast** to the elven camp of Shadowthorn (bring a {item:Machete}). The hole to the Time Ring Quest room is at {coord:33060,32182,7}. To leave, go back to where you fell and climb up with the {item:Rope}; then cross the swamps **northwest** back to Venore.
Dead Tree with the Bloodkiss Flower
Hole in Shadowthorn (climb up with the Rope)

If you get the {item:Animal Fetish}: in the {wiki:Orc Fortress} (Ulderek's Rock), go up one floor on the mountain, at the northeasternmost point of the fort. The {wiki:Orc Fortress|Orc Fortress} (Ulderek's Rock) is **northwest** of Venore, southeast of Ab'Dendriel and east of Ferngrims Gate. After picking up the fetish, go back the same way out of the fort (there are big groups of orcs: a {item:Stealth Ring} helps).

If you get the {item:Worm Queen Tooth}, go to the dragon cave of {wiki:Fibula} (you need the {item:Key 3940} and the {item:Key 3980}); the quest door is in the northern part, north of the spawn of 3 Dragon Lords. If you get the {item:Deep Crystal}, go down on the way to {wiki:Hellgate} with the {item:Key 3012}: the crystal is in the room with a single {creature:Giant Spider}. **Fibula:** take the tunnel far to the **south** of Thais, enter the Fibula Dungeon through the well in the middle of the village and open the door with the {item:Key 3940} ({npc:Simon the Beggar} sells it for 800 gp). The {item:Key 3980} is obtained by using a hole to the **west**, after the teleport and the level 50 gate. To leave the dragon cave, the portal in the **southwest** part of the last room takes you back to the dungeon entrance. **Hellgate:** enter as in mission 1 (the {item:Key 3012} door in Ab'Dendriel) and leave through the exit route described in mission 1 (Rope + Levitate or 6 Parcels).
Location of the Worm Queen Tooth (Fibula)
Location of the Deep Crystal (Hellgate route)
Take each ingredient to {npc:Telas} and say {key:mission}. Then say {key:mission} and {key:yes} again for the next ingredient. With the third, the mission is complete.
You have to take a "shower" of Yalahari energy in the {wiki:Factory Quarter} to be able to enter the Fenrock complex.

In the {wiki:Factory Quarter}, go down at {coord:32890,31321,7}. On this floor there are 4 {creature:Damaged Worker Golem|Damaged Worker Golems} and 1 {creature:Worker Golem}. Enter the Factory Quarter as in mission 2 (guard {npc:Peter}).

Go down again at {coord:32896,31309,8}. Here you find 5 {creature:Worker Golem|Worker Golems}, 4 {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals} and 2 {creature:Mad Scientist|Mad Scientists}, probably all at the same time.

Walk **north** and go through the quest door. You arrive at {coord:32894,31297,9}. Stand on the {item:Iron Floor} and press the blue {item:Button}: this Yalahari elevator takes you **two floors down**.
There are no creatures on this floor. Walk to the shower and pass through it. You see the message *"You were showered by strange energy!"*.

Go back the same way: return to the Yalahari elevator and the two floors above, go through the quest door to the **south** and go up at the two spots where you went down ({coord:32896,31309,8} and {coord:32890,31321,7}) to the surface of the Factory Quarter.
Go back to {npc:Telas}, say {key:mission} and answer {key:yes} to receive the charge. This starts mission 12 right away.
You have to bring back a {item:Golem Head} from Fenrock. Alternative: buy it from Black Bert for 25,000 gp and hand it straight to Telas (it skips the entire mission, including the final fight).
{wiki:Fenrock} is an island **west** of Yalahar. Go to the dock at the **northwest** end of the {wiki:Foreigner Quarter} and talk to {npc:Maris}: {key:hi}, {key:fenrock}, {key:yes} (100 gp).
Go to {wiki:Fenrock}, to the **northern** end of the {creature:Tortoise|Tortoises} area. Step into the teleport. It is **two floors below** the surface.
Talk to the {npc:Golem Servant}: {key:hi}, {key:here}, {key:lift}, {key:repairs} and, when you are ready, {key:yes}. From here the clock starts ticking.
Put on the {item:Dwarven Ring} and use {spell:Haste} / {item:Boots of Haste} **when you accept the task**, not when you pick up the item.
The golem asks for one item at a time. Go to the right hole, open the container indicated in the table and bring the item back quickly: the items spoil when they leave their preservation field.
Rooms (holes) where you get the items — see table
Map with the position of each component and tool
The grates on the floor make you {wiki:Drunk}. You can go around them, but you lose time. If you do not hand in the item in time, you have to start over and the counter goes back to zero.

Go back to the {npc:Golem Servant}, say {key:hi} and {key:yes} to hand in. Then say {key:yes} to continue and he asks for the next item. You need **8 repairs**. The golem may ask for the same item several times in a row.
When you hear *"Repair procedure complete! Elevator fully operational."*, step on the elevator. You appear two floors below.
Go down to the final room
Go down the stairs: you arrive at a big floor with no creatures. In the **north** there are two stairs going down; use either one.

On this floor you have to fight {creature:Rift Scythe|Rift Scythes}, {creature:Rift Worm|Rift Worms} and {creature:War Golem|War Golems} to reach the box in the **south**. Stay away from the War Golems and control the Rift Scythes and Worms by throwing bombs (field runes) all over the place. Walk hugging the wall. Open the box and take the {item:Golem Head}.
A knight surrounded by Rift Scythes, War Golems and Rift Worms in the final room
The 4 War Golems next to the box are summons: they respawn every time you kill them. Do not run through the middle of the room, you easily get cornered.

Go back the same way: cross the room to the **north** carefully, go up the stairs and return to the elevator and the {npc:Golem Servant} area, and leave through the teleport you came in by. Go up to the surface of Fenrock and, at the dock, talk to {npc:Maris}: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}. To take the head to Telas, take the boat to Edron as in mission 2.
Take the {item:Golem Head} to {npc:Telas} and say {key:mission}. You receive 5 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}. He asks you to wait **one Tibian day (1 real-time hour)**.
After an hour, talk to {npc:Telas} upstairs: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. He asks you to meet him in the laboratory, in the basement.
Use the **lever** in Telas's house to go down to the laboratory. Down there, talk to Telas: {key:hi}, {key:mission}.
Pull the lever next to you to activate the {creature:Telas Golem}.
Talk to {npc:Telas} again: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. You receive 25,000 experience, the **Golem in the Gears** achievement and access to the laboratory.
25,000 experience + Golem in the Gears achievement
In the laboratory, open the box with the {item:Golem Wrench}. Use it on one of the {wiki:Modified Gnarlhound|Modified Gnarlhounds} in the cage to get the mount.
From now on, say {key:trade} to {npc:Telas} (upstairs) to sell him rare metals and crystals.

Missions 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 10 and 12 can be replaced by buying the item from {npc:Black Bert}; in mission 9 he only sells {item:Headache Pill|Headache Pills}, which save time but do not skip the mission.
After completing mission 13, if you say {key:mission} to Telas in the laboratory or the one upstairs, he comments on the golem's strange behaviour (just lore).
